bull_case: Management has converted heavy R&D into multiple product families, strong revenue growth and positive operating cash flow while maintaining a debt-free balance sheet. Product ramps have often arrived ahead of prior expectations.
bear_case: SBC is high, an Amazon customer warrant creates contingent dilution, and public operating history is short. Capital allocation has not yet been tested through a full semiconductor downcycle or a large acquisition integration.
thesis: Management allocation is strong but not yet elite. R&D spending produced rapid expansion from retimers into switches, memory, Ethernet and custom/optical connectivity, while cash generation and liquidity remained strong. Scorpio's Q3 leadership ramp was pulled forward versus prior expectations. Governance is conventional and no accounting-integrity issue is identified, but elevated SBC and customer warrants temper alignment quality.

evidence.claim: FY2025 R&D was $304.0M, up 51% YoY, while revenue rose 115% to $852.5M and operating income turned positive at $173.4M.
Management expected Scorpio to become the largest product family in Q3, one quarter ahead of prior expectations.
June cash plus marketable securities were about $1.253B and the company had no material funded debt, preserving strategic flexibility.
The February 2026 Amazon warrant covers up to 3.262M shares at $142.82 and vests with specified purchase-performance conditions.
H1 2026 stock-based compensation was $112.9M, material relative to GAAP operating income.

counterevidence: Customer-linked warrants exchange equity value for strategic purchases.
Management's public-company record is short and untested through a severe AI/semiconductor downturn.
unknowns: Management response to the first major demand contraction.
falsifiers: Persistent dilution above FCF/share growth would lower capital-allocation quality.
Large acquisitions with poor post-close returns would weaken the score.
Accounting-control or related-party issues would trigger integrity review.

hard_veto_flags.veto: 경영진 정직성 또는 회계 신뢰성 훼손
hard_veto_flags.rationale: No restatement, auditor dispute, material-control failure or comparable integrity event was identified in reviewed filings.

key_kpis.name: R&D productivity
key_kpis.threshold: revenue and FCF growth outpace R&D growth over cycle

key_kpis.name: new-product schedule execution
key_kpis.threshold: major ramps on or ahead of disclosed targets

subscores.rationale: No buyback benchmark exists; R&D and targeted capability investment have produced rapid revenue, margin and cash-flow expansion. High SBC prevents an 80+ allocation score.
Filings and governance appear conventional with no identified accounting-reliability event, but the public track record is short and customer warrants add alignment complexity.
Management expanded from retimers into multiple adjacent product families and pulled the Scorpio revenue-leadership milestone forward by a quarter.

uncertainties.rationale: Long-term returns on optical/custom investments are not yet observable.
No current red flag is identified, but public-company history is limited.
Execution has not yet been tested through a major cyclical downturn.
